groups.label: Caught going soft, after four years of saying no dog
groups.note: Caught, as if found out. The photograph and the lean in the yard settle it before the argument ends, and the goodnight ritual is the tenderness she would once have laughed at. Home now has the dog in its description.
groups.description: The one who said no dog finds herself talking to one at half six, won over before she would admit it

groups.label: Out on the lane, where the day becomes hers
groups.note: The walk she resented the first year is now the part of the day that is hers. She watches the dog's nose and the bad mood does not survive it.
groups.description: Forty minutes nobody can claim, her head quiet beside a dog's joy in a wet hedge

groups.label: Five years of it never getting said
groups.note: The morning row is never had because the wag takes it away, and the half nine list is closed with a chin on a knee. She holds both readings open: good for them, or a way round each other.
groups.description: A dog who takes the mood off her, and a couple who talk about the dog instead

groups.label: Wanted at the door, and finding the dog is easier
groups.note: Being wanted, plainly, is what brings her home. Her partner's remark lands, and she will not pretend it is not true: the dog needs nothing to have been got right.
groups.description: A welcome like no other brings her home, and says something about the people there

groups.label: Grieving in advance a dog who is snoring at her
groups.note: The drive to the vet shows her the size of it, and the thorn makes it a rehearsal. She stops the thought every time, and laughs at herself for grieving a sleeping dog.
groups.description: A thorn shows her the end already rehearsed, and a house that goes flat without her

groups.label: Goodnight out loud, and two thumps back
groups.description: A ritual too ridiculous to skip

groups.label: The first year's regret, never said
groups.note: It went away, mostly. It comes back on wet Sunday nights, and her partner has never heard it.
groups.description: Thinking it a mistake, and never able to say so about a dog with a past

groups.label: Letting her run, and ageing at the gate
groups.description: Her freedom weighed against the worry every morning, and always let go

groups.label: Closest on the night it cost her something
groups.note: The bad night proves what the easy days cannot. The rules of the house are kept without a word between them.
groups.description: Turning back together in the rain, an agreement neither of them wrote down

groups.label: Cracking first at twenty past six
groups.description: Who gets up, and what being the one who always goes says

groups.label: A dog between them at half nine
groups.note: Two ways at once, her own words for it, and the answer changes with the week.
groups.description: The voices, the list nobody starts, and not knowing which it is

groups.label: Coming home for the dog, and what that says
groups.description: Easier than a person, and kinder to her than to the people in the house

groups.label: A house on standby without her
groups.note: The quiet is wrong. Two hours flat, and the thought of longer is the one she does not finish.
groups.description: Two hours at the groomer's and the home is a set, furniture waiting
